s.note: the beignets Tiana makes for Charlotte
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 2 eggs, 50g melted butter and 250ml evaporated milk with warm water to a soft dough and prove 2 hours. Roll out, cut into squares and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Bury under icing sugar and serve hot.

s.note: the Mardi Gras parade in New Orleans
s.how: Chop green olives and giardiniera together for an olive salad. Hollow a cob loaf slightly and layer with olive salad, salami, ham and provolone, then more olive salad. Wrap tightly, press under a heavy weight overnight and cut into small wedges.

m.note: Tiana's Palace, her own restaurant at last
m.how: Simmer 200g polenta in 1L water, stirring, until thick, then beat in grated cheddar. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp, add crushed garlic and 500g peeled green prawns with Cajun seasoning and cook 3 minutes. Spoon over the polenta with spring onion.

w.how: Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar and a pinch of cinnamon until bubbling. Add 4 halved bananas and cook 2 minutes. Pour in 60ml dark rum and carefully light it, letting the flames die down. Spoon over bowls of vanilla ice cream straight away.

d.note: a New Orleans morning, beignets on the side
d.how: Brew 500ml strong coffee from 50g dark-roast ground coffee, chicory blend if you can get it. Heat 500ml milk until steaming and frothy. Pour coffee and milk into 4 mugs at the same time, half and half.
